fusions.name: Barded Ram
fusions.desc: You rush up to 7 tiles to the target and ram it for 30 damage plus 5% of a boss or elite's maximum health, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Farrier's Iron
fusions.desc: You buck, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocking them 3 tiles back. Each hit has a 40% chance of [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: No Slower for Steel
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 30% for 10 seconds, and your movement speed rises 20% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Plate Weighs Nothing
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently 8% higher, and you carry 6% physical resistance.
